name: Fading Twilight
passiveDesc: Has three states: Evengleam increases DMG dealt by 6%/7.5%/9%/10.5%/12%; Afterglow by 10%/12.5%/15%/17.5%/20%; and Dawnblaze by 14%/17.5%/21%/24.5%/28%. When attacks hit opponents, this weapon will switch to the next state. This weapon can change states once every 7s. The character equipping this weapon can still trigger the state switch while not on the field.
